findings.namedBuyers: Catherine Schmutz Nicod, conservatrice: the City assigns her museum/site development and management; commercially relevant first contact for partnership feasibility and the actual lodging decision-maker. Vincent Lieber, conservateur: the City assigns him collections and exhibitions; relevant for Kunz visiting contributors and programme logistics. Both are listed on the current official team page. Neither is verified as accommodation buyer or contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: An official future programme is published within the requested horizon: Kunz, photographes à Nyon, at Château de Nyon, Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. Vernissage: 3 June 2027; public exhibition: 4 June 2027–30 April 2028. These are activity dates, not publication dates, and do not establish overnight demand. Earlier in-horizon activities include Contes de Noël on 16 December 2026 at 14:00 and 15:30 and a Nicolas Lieber guided visit on 31 January 2027 at 11:00. No next edition of an association conference or preferred-lodging programme was identified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL specification: good territorial alignment with Nyon/La Côte, but only conditional lodging fit. Test guest/contributor stays, visiting production or installation teams, and overnight guests of privately booked receptions, plus optional hotel meetings/F&B. No such room demand is yet verified. This is a local cultural-venue/referral proposition, not a resort retreat or downtown-Geneva congress. Public family activities and museum visits do not substantiate a 20–120-room block; 100 reception places and a 25-person guided-tour maximum are capacities, not room demand. Do not sell a whole-house allocation or infer demand from the exhibition duration.
findings.venueCommitments: Kunz is announced at Château de Nyon, Place du Château, CH-1260 Nyon. Geography: Nyon / La Côte corridor, canton of Vaud; not Founex, Geneva city or Lausanne. This is an exhibition venue commitment, not a hotel commitment. The City separately rents the Château reception room for up to 100 standing guests; the civil-wedding room has a 45-person maximum. Capacities are not attendance forecasts.
findings.historicalRotation: The archive establishes successive exhibitions at the same museum, not a rotating conference: Reflets et transparence, 27 June–30 November 2025; SOLITUDE, 19 December 2025–11 January 2026; Le coq et la sirène, 26 February–10 May 2026. Ruines et imaginaire runs 10 July 2026–31 January 2027 and is ongoing as of 16 November 2026. Kunz follows in June 2027. No same-event destination rotation or annual Kunz recurrence is established. Separately, Museum Time publishes monthly English tours rotating among three Nyon museums; this is not evidence of travelling residential-event demand.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for Kunz, museum activities and third-party reception clients: reviewed official programme and visitor pages publish no housing bureau, host hotel, edition-specific hotel list, room block or accommodation RFP. All hotels in a published edition-specific housing list: none identified. Do not label sourcing open. Meeting-space sourcing is explicit: the City says “Toute réservation se fait dorénavant par le biais de notre plateforme”; changes/cancellations go to location.salles@nyon.ch. Museum group visits are booked directly: “réserver au moins 15 jours à l’avance directement au Musée”, via publics@chateaudenyon.ch. These are venue/tour booking routes, not lodging procurement. Separate commercial evidence: a Wine & Dine offer names Hôtel La Barcarolle as its participating hotel, includes three hotel nights and a tasting in the Château wine cellar, and states “Réservable toute l’année 2025/2026 sauf du 20 au 27 juillet 2026”. This is a hotel-led leisure package, not Kunz housing or proof of a museum-wide exclusive agreement.
findings.organizationStructure: Municipal cultural institution linked to the Ville de Nyon / Service de la culture, co-directed by two conservators; not an identified association, corporate conference owner, PCO or DMC. City room rentals and museum-led cultural activities are separate routes. For externally rented receptions, the actual client and its hotel buyer remain unidentified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hôtel La Barcarolle has a published, separate three-night leisure package incorporating a Château cellar tasting; this supports competition for cultural/leisure packaging, not incumbent housing for Kunz. Base Nyon markets itself as within walking distance of the Château; inference: walkable Nyon accommodation may be more convenient than Founex for independent visitors. No sourced sell-out, overflow, displaced room block or exclusive lodging arrangement was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Catherine Schmutz Nicod first, copying Vincent Lieber only for exhibition logistics. Propose a short needs-assessment for Kunz preparation/opening and private-reception referrals: who travels, who pays/books, required nights/rooms, existing hotel agreements and whether referrals are permitted. Ask the municipal room-rental service how external hirers can opt into hotel introductions; do not request client personal data without consent. Offer a transfer-costed Founex option only after demand is established. Keep as exploratory partnership, not a qualified dated accommodation opportunity, until buyer, room demand and sourcing accessibility are evidenced.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The ongoing Ruines exhibition and announced Kunz exhibition are museum programmes, not accessible hotel tenders. No verified lodging procurement window exists. Public tickets, guided-visit reservations and municipal room-hire availability must not be confused with rooms available to capture. A relationship-development approach is possible; current hotel revenue is unproven.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: a non-exclusive referral or cultural-package relationship may be worth testing for future reception clients and genuinely non-local contributors. Kunz gives a dated conversation anchor, not a confirmed group lead or annual recurrence. Any transfer plan, rate offer and block should follow verified guest origins, nights, room needs and decision rights. Existing La Barcarolle leisure packaging must not be represented as an open block to displace.
